name: AH 3121
title: Immunology for the Medical Laboratory Sciences
description: Mechanisms of innate and acquired immunity, antigen-antibody interactions, function of the human immune system in normal and diseased states.
requirement_description: MLSC 3130 or MCB 2610 which may be taken concurrently; open to students in: Allied Health Sciences, Diagnostic Genetic Sciences, Medical Laboratory Sciences and Diagnostic Genetic Sciences certificate students; open to juniors or higher.
